body.x: Incheon IT Promotion Agency(IITPA, Director Sung-kap Cho, www.iitpa.or.kr) and 8 export promising companies located in Incheon have been participating in CES 2012 (Consumer Electronics Show 2012) held in Las Vegas, Seoul from Jan 10 to 13 (local time).
IITPA supported entry fee, on-the-spot market research, finding buyers, promotion&marketing and others for 8 export promising companies.

The 8 companies that will participate in CES 2012 are VIVA KOREA(CCTV camera, DVR), Sechang Instrument(web personalization platform based on cloud), YUJIN System(security equipment), Huria(Bone Conduction headphone), PPYPLE(smart phone accessories like smart phone, handsfree holder and others), ChoisTechnology (PC control devices for presentation), Innoworks(plastic case, screen protector), Mini Robot(dans performance robot, robot-applied game machine).
Incheon IT Promotion Agency have prepared exhaustively from prior meeting to on-the-site marketing in Las vegas for real fruits of 8 companies at CES 2012.
